questions.question: Among the given collections which one is I/O index based?
Which among the given statements are correct about the Stack collection?

options.text: It can be used for evaluation of expressions
It is used to maintain a FILO list
Top most element of the Stack collection can be accessed using the Peek()

questions.explanation: A stack works on the FILO (First In, Last Out) principle. It is widely used to evaluate expressions like postfix and prefix. The Peek() operation allows accessing the top element of the stack without removing it, so all given statements are correct.

questions.question: A HashTable t maintains a collection of names of states and capital city of each state. Which among the following finds out whether "New delhi" state is present in the collection or not?
questions.explanation: The question explicitly states that "New delhi" is a state, so it must be stored as a key in the Hashtable. ContainsKey() is the correct method to check whether a given state exists in the collection.
